  "description": "Odixcity Consulting is an International Hr consulting and procurement firm. With expertise in Recruitment &amp; Selection, Performance management, Training &amp; Development, Compensation and benefits as well as Outsourcing of goods and services for organizations.

We are &nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Creative Marketing Lead

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full- Time (On-Site)

Job Summary


	We are looking for a creative architect with a revenue mindset; someone who can look at our daily operations and spot 10 different ways to turn them into marketing gold.
	Your mission is to direct our entire content strategy, lead a creative team, and ensure our brand stays top-of-mind through compelling, authentic storytelling.


Responsibilities


	Develop a monthly content calendar that aligns with our business goals, drawing inspiration from daily activities, client wins, behind-the-scenes moments, and industry trends.
	Direct and mentor a team of video editors, graphic designers, and videographers. Assign tasks, provide creative feedback, and ensure brand consistency across all outputs.
	Plan, execute, and optimize paid ad campaigns across Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
	Manage budgets, targeting, and bidding to maximize ROI and lead generation.
	Develop and execute strategies to directly bring in new clients through both organic and paid channels.
	Identify high-value target audiences and tailor campaigns to attract them.
	Create lead magnets, landing pages, and nurture sequences that convert interest into booked services.
	Proactively identify marketing angles from our daily workflow, turning routine processes into case studies, testimonials, tutorials, or viral social moments.
	Coordinate shoots, manage post-production timelines, and ensure deliverables are high-quality and on schedule.
	Track performance metrics (engagement, reach, conversions) and refine strategies based on data, not just gut feeling.


Requirements


	Proven Experience: 3 Years+ experience of coordinating marketing efforts, managing creative teams, or outstanding digital marketing skills (portfolio is required).
	Creative Instinct: You see content everywhere. You can walk into a room, observe a 10-minute interaction, and pitch three different ways to film or promote it.
	Leadership Ability: You know how to inspire editors and designers to do their best work.
	Technical Savvy: Comfortable with scheduling tools, analytics dashboards, and familiarity with social media platforms (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn), basic video/ design principles, and scheduling/analytic tools.
	Location: Must currently reside in Port Harcourt or must be willing to relocate.
	Communication: Excellent English skills, both written and verbal, to craft compelling narratives and lead your team effectively.


Renumeration
N300,000 per month.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV: cvs@odixcityconsulting.com.ng using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

Creative Marketing Lead Job at Odixcity Consulting




        
    

        
        Odixcity Consulting is an International Hr consulting and procurement firm. With expertise in Recruitment & Selection, Performance management, Training & Development, Compensation and benefits as well as Outsourcing of goods and services for organizations.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Creative Marketing Lead

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full- Time (On-Site)

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are looking for a creative architect with a revenue mindset; someone who can look at our daily operations and spot 10 different ways to turn them into marketing gold.
	Your mission is to direct our entire content strategy, lead a creative team, and ensure our brand stays top-of-mind through compelling, authentic storytelling.


Responsibilities


	Develop a monthly content calendar that aligns with our business goals, drawing inspiration from daily activities, client wins, behind-the-scenes moments, and industry trends.
	Direct and mentor a team of video editors, graphic designers, and videographers. Assign tasks, provide creative feedback, and ensure brand consistency across all outputs.
	Plan, execute, and optimize paid ad campaigns across Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
	Manage budgets, targeting, and bidding to maximize ROI and lead generation.
	Develop and execute strategies to directly bring in new clients through both organic and paid channels.
	Identify high-value target audiences and tailor campaigns to attract them.
	Create lead magnets, landing pages, and nurture sequences that convert interest into booked services.
	Proactively identify marketing angles from our daily workflow, turning routine processes into case studies, testimonials, tutorials, or viral social moments.
	Coordinate shoots, manage post-production timelines, and ensure deliverables are high-quality and on schedule.
	Track performance metrics (engagement, reach, conversions) and refine strategies based on data, not just gut feeling.


Requirements


	Proven Experience: 3 Years+ experience of coordinating marketing efforts, managing creative teams, or outstanding digital marketing skills (portfolio is required).
	Creative Instinct: You see content everywhere. You can walk into a room, observe a 10-minute interaction, and pitch three different ways to film or promote it.
	Leadership Ability: You know how to inspire editors and designers to do their best work.
	Technical Savvy: Comfortable with scheduling tools, analytics dashboards, and familiarity with social media platforms (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn), basic video/ design principles, and scheduling/analytic tools.
	Location: Must currently reside in Port Harcourt or must be willing to relocate.
	Communication: Excellent English skills, both written and verbal, to craft compelling narratives and lead your team effectively.


Renumeration
N300,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

HR Lead Job at Enoella Consult




        
    

        
        Enoella Consult - Our client is a leading indigenous group of companies in oil & gas services, NDT equipment sales, and industrial equipment distribution.

They are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: HR Lead
Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are seeking an experienced and hands-on HR Lead to own the full people-management function across the group — recruitment, onboarding, performance management, employee relations, HR compliance and organisational effectiveness — in a fast-moving, technically-driven environment.


Responsibilities


	Lead end-to-end recruitment, selection and onboarding for technical, commercial and support roles
	Design, implement and monitor the performance management / KPI process, including quarterly reviews
	Maintain accurate employee records, contracts, job descriptions and organisational charts
	Ensure full compliance with Nigerian labour laws, statutory obligations (pension, NSITF, ITF, PAYE) and company policy
	Oversee payroll inputs, leave, attendance and staff welfare administration
	Coordinate training, certification tracking and competency development for technical and support staff
	Manage employee relations, grievances and disciplinary processes fairly and promptly
	Advise management on organisational structure, change management and culture
	Supervise Admin / Front Desk and office-support staff


Requirements


	B.Sc / HND in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Social Sciences or a related field
	Minimum of 7 years of HR experience, at least 3 years in a lead or managerial HR role
	Membership of CIPM (MCIPM) or equivalent professional HR qualification — strongly preferred
	Experience in oil & gas, engineering, industrial or technical-services organisations is a strong advantage
	Sound knowledge of the Nigerian Labour Act and HR compliance requirements
	Strong communication, discretion, leadership and conflict-resolution skills
	Proficiency in MS Office; experience with HR information systems is an advantage.

	To manage the company&#39;s accounting operations, financial records, reporting, cash flow and statutory obligations, ensuring accurate financial information, effective financial control and compliance with applicable accounting standards and tax regulations.

	Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records.
	Prepare monthly management accounts, income statements and financial reports.
	Reconcile bank statements, ledgers and other financial accounts.
	Monitor income, expenses, accounts receivable and accounts payable.


Budgeting &amp; Financial Control:


	Assist in preparing budgets and monitoring expenditure against approved budgets.
	Monitor cash flow and support financial planning.
	Ensure financial transactions are properly documented and authorised.
	Track outstanding payments and receivables and identify financial discrepancies.


Tax &amp; Statutory Compliance:


	Prepare and maintain records required for tax computations and statutory filings.
	Ensure compliance with applicable tax laws, accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
	Coordinate audit documentation and provide supporting financial records when required.


Payments &amp; Financial Administration:


	Process supplier invoices, approved expense claims and other authorised payments.
	Execute salary payments based on payroll schedules prepared and verified by HR.
	Maintain payment records and ensure timely settlement of approved financial obligations.
	Work with HR to resolve payroll-related payment discrepancies without assuming responsibility for payroll preparation.


ERP &amp; Accounting Systems:


	Maintain accurate financial data within the company&#39;s ERP and accounting systems.
	Use QuickBooks for bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, invoicing, expense tracking and financial reporting.
	Generate financial reports and support improvements in accounting processes and system controls.

	Accuracy and timeliness of financial reports.
	Timely completion of bank and ledger reconciliations.

	Strong proficiency in QuickBooks, Microsoft Excel, ERP systems and accounting software.
	Good knowledge of financial reporting, bookkeeping, reconciliations, budgeting and Nigerian tax compliance.

	QuickBooks and ERP proficiency.
	Bank reconciliation and bookkeeping.

	Tax compliance and statutory reporting.
	Accuracy, integrity and attention to detail.


Salary
N150,000 - N200,000 monthly.
